name: Tofu Soba Bowl
ingredients: 60 g dry soba noodles (check they are 100% buckwheat if gluten-free)
Dressing: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 garlic clove (grated), juice of ½ lime
steps: Cook the soba in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain, rinse under cold water and drain again.
Sear the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Steam the broccoli and carrot for 3 minutes.
Whisk the dressing and toss with the noodles, cabbage and vegetables.
Top with the tofu, spring onion and chilli flakes.
note: Soba has more protein and fibre than regular wheat noodles; keep the portion to about 30 g dry per person.
